Generate comprehensive report\n  const report = generateReport(overheadMetrics, fixtureAnalysis, hookAnalysis);\n\n  // 5. Report saved to: ${reportPath}`);\n  return reportPath;\n}\n\n/**\n * Analyze fixture usage across all test files\n */\nfunction analyzeFixtureUsage() {\n  const testDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'tests/unit');\n  const testFiles = fs.readdirSync(testDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.test.js'));\n\n  const analysis = {\n    totalTestFiles: testFiles.length,\n    fixtures: {},\n    mocks: {},\n    imports: {},\n    complexityScores: {}\n  };\n\n  for (const file of testFiles) {\n    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(testDir, file), 'utf-8');\n\n    // Track fixture imports\n    const fixtureMatches = content.matchAll(/import\\s+.*?\\s+from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]/g);\n    for (const match of fixtureMatches) {\n      const importPath = match[1];\n      if (importPath.includes('helper') || importPath.includes('utils') ||\n          importPath.includes('mock') || importPath.includes('fixture')) {\n        analysis.fixtures[importPath] = (analysis.fixtures[importPath] || 0) + 1;\n      }\n      analysis.imports[importPath] = (analysis.imports[importPath] || 0) + 1;\n    }\n\n    // Track mock patterns\n    const mockMatches = content.match(/vi\\.mock\\(/g) || [];\n    analysis.mocks[file] = mockMatches.length;\n\n    // Calculate complexity score based on patterns\n    let complexity = 0;\n    complexity += mockMatches.length * 2; // mocks are expensive\n    complexity += (content.match(/beforeAll\\(/g) || []).length * 3;\n    complexity += (content.match(/beforeEach\\(/g) || []).length * 2;\n    complexity += (content.match(/afterEach\\(/g) || []).length * 2;\n    complexity += (content.match(/afterAll\\(/g) || []).length * 3;\n    complexity += (content.match(/describe\\(/g) || []).length * 0.5;\n    complexity += (content.match(/it\\(/g) || []).length * 0.1; // 0.3ms average test execution\n\n  const totalRuntime = totalOverhead + estimatedTestExecution;\n\n  return {\n    totalRuntime,\n    setupOverhead: totalSetupOverhead,\n    teardownOverhead: totalTeardownOverhead,\n    fixtureOverhead: estimatedFixtureOverhead,\n    testExecution: estimatedTestExecution,\n    overheadRatio: totalOverhead / estimatedTestExecution,\n    percentageBreakdown: {\n      setup: (totalSetupOverhead / totalRuntime * 100).toFixed(1),\n      teardown: (totalTeardownOverhead / totalRuntime * 100).toFixed(1),\n      fixtures: (estimatedFixtureOverhead / totalRuntime * 100).toFixed(1),\n      testExecution: (estimatedTestExecution / totalRuntime * 100).toFixed(1)\n    },\n    hookBreakdown: estimatedHookOverhead,\n    fixtureBreakdown: fixtureAnalysis.fixtures,\n    hookAnalysis\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate comprehensive report\n */\nfunction generateReport(metrics, fixtureAnalysis, hookAnalysis) {\n  const m = metrics;\n\n  return `# Test Setup/Teardown Overhead Measurement\n\n**Bead ID**: bf-2i0o4\n**Generated**: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n**Analysis Scope**: ${fixtureAnalysis.totalTestFiles} test files\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nThis analysis measured the time spent in test infrastructure versus actual test execution across the entire test suite.\n\n| Metric | Value | Status |\n|--------|-------|--------|\n| **Total Runtime** | ${m.totalRuntime.toFixed(2)}ms | - |\n| **Setup Time** | ${m.setupOverhead.toFixed(2)}ms (${m.percentageBreakdown.setup}%) | ${parseFloat(m.percentageBreakdown.setup) > 30 ?
